2. All payments of principal, interest and other amounts to be made Exempuon
by the Government of Malaysia (hereinafter referred to as "the duties, levies
Government") to Kreditanstalt fur Wiederaufbau, Frankfurt/Main, as al
Federal Republic of Germany (hereinafter referred to as "KFW") under

a Loan Agreement entered into between the Government and KFW

on 21st December 1976, relating to a loan of DM31,960,286 (Thirty

one million nine hundred and sixty thousand two hundred and eighty

six Deutsch Marks) for the purpose of financing the purchase of tele-
communications equipment by Telecommunications Department of the
Government of Malaysia from Siemens Aktiengesellschaft Munich,
Germany, shall be exempted from any and all present or future taxes,

duties and levies of the Government and from the provisions of any

written law relating to Exchange Control.

REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE
PERSONS ACT 1969

REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE PERSONS
(AMENDMENT) ORDER 1977

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 15 of
the Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969, the
Minister makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Registration of Criminals and
Undesirable Persons (Amendment) Order 1977 and shall be deemed to
have come into force on the 1st January 1977.

2. Part IV of the First Schedule (Sabah), Part IV of the First Schedule

(Sarawak) and Part VI of the First Schedule (States of Malaya) to the

Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969, are

Dunnaai  by adding thereto the offences specified in the Schedule
ereto.

8 and 9.

Pada menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diberi oleh seksyen-kecil (1)
seksyen 15 Akta Pendaftaran Penjenayah dan Orang-orang Yang Tak
Diingini 1969, Menteri membuat perintah yang berikut:

1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan sebagai Perintah Pendaftaran
Penjenayah dan Orang-orang Yang Tak Diingini (Pindaan) (No. 2) 1977
dan hendaklah disifatkan sebagai telah mula berkuatkuasa pada 3hb
September 1976.
